Enqueue a durable discovery job for each enabled schedule target and return immediately. Designed for invocation by Cloud Scheduler or other cron triggers; the durable worker performs the discovery work. Re-triggering the same target on the same day reuses the already-enqueued job, so a duplicate cron fire is a no-op.
